summary: Backend smoke + mobile static verification for HomeScreen data-loading fix. All 5 backend endpoints (home/app, song-categories, layout/home-filters, recommendations/next-songs, albums/{id}) return valid non-empty data. All 4 mobile static code checks pass (undefined refs removed, retry logic in place, preloadNextTracks wired to both playTrack and PlaybackActiveTrackChanged, api.js interceptor with __retried guard).

backend_endpoint_results.GET /api/home/app: 200 - 12 sections, hero.items present, multiple sections with items

critical_code_review_comments: Note: /api/home/app hero section (sections[0]) itself has items:0 but hero object at root has populated items - mobile likely reads root hero. Not a bug, just structure to be aware of.

next-songs required extracting a song_id from an album (home/app returns album entities only). Mobile should fetch a real song_id from album or now-playing state before calling next-songs - already the pattern per fixture logic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is on local dev mongo (mongodb://localhost:27017/gracefy_db) with prod clone (~121 songs, 49 albums). /api/home/app returns albums (entity_type) not raw songs — to get a song_id fetch an album detail first. All mobile bad-network/preload/undefined-ref fixes verified in source.
